Product Description

MegaPC Custom Micro Desktop - Created Using Dell Pro Micro QCM1250

Compact Office Computing
A black micro desktop designed for office productivity and everyday work.

Processor and Graphics
Intel Core Ultra 7 265T provides 20 cores and up to 5.3 GHz turbo frequency, paired with integrated Intel Graphics.

Memory and Storage
This base configuration includes 16GB DDR5 RAM and a 256GB SSD. Hardware customization concerns RAM and storage, while other hardware remains factory configured.

Connections for Daily Work
Standard HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-A, USB-C and Ethernet connections support everyday desk workflows. Wi-Fi and Bluetooth support are recorded for this product.

Windows 11 Pro
Windows 11 Pro is the seller-delivered operating system.

Warranty and Disclosure
MegaPC provides a 1-year limited warranty on the upgraded RAM and SSD components. The original Dell manufacturer warranty remains valid on all remaining factory components, so you are covered on both the base machine and our upgrades. The original seal has been opened solely for upgrading purposes.
